provenance.label_use: PCA label-free; error contrast uses discovery labels; all candidates selected using tuning labels.
provenance.selection: No native source accuracy regression; maximize source-macro native gain, source-macro rotation accuracy, negative source-macro NLL, negative edit norm; candidate order final tie-break.

pca_diagnostics.method: exact float64 symmetric covariance eigh; no labels or scores
pca_diagnostics.question_weighting: equal source; equal question within source; equal option/rotation within question

supervised_contrast_diagnostics.definition:
Analytic label-supervised contrast on native-order discovery mistakes.

Pick the highest-scoring wrong option in native order. Average gold-minus-
wrong activations over all rotations, then mistakes within each source,
then sources with at least one mistake. Never reads tuning labels.

protected_contrast_diagnostics.method: SVD orthogonal projection outside already-correct gold-vs-wrong native margin span
